style: A square 1:1 collectible badge illustration. Style: vintage pen-and-ink engraving, like an antique tarot or trading card. Ivory/cream linework on a deep black background, fine cross-hatching and stippling for shading, very limited color: only the accent color named below, used sparingly. A thin ornate double border with small engraved corner flourishes, identical on every card. One single centered subject with a bold, readable silhouette that still reads when the card is shown at 128x128 pixels; keep the background simple. No text, no letters, no numbers, no signature, no watermark.
